title: markdown-index wikilink graph
description: The wikilink graph: every resolved edge keyed by its content address, the same address EdgeCID computes. Identical edges share a content address and dedupe to a single entry.

label.description: WEBSITE when the target begins http:// or https://, INTERNAL otherwise.

title.description: The pipe alias when the wikilink has one, otherwise the raw target text.

from_document_id.description: UUID of the document holding the wikilink. Only documents with a non-empty UUID produce edges.

to_document_id.description: The target's UUID when the link resolves in the index, otherwise the raw target text.
